Basics

addBlade() can create a blade without binding.

const pane = new Pane();
pane.addBlade({
  view: 'slider',
  label: 'brightness',
  min: 0,
  max: 1,
  value: 0.5,
});

Most of blades need a specific view and other required parameters. See the sections below for details.

If you are a TypeScript user, need to cast a created blade to a specific type to access full functionalities:

const b = pane.addBlade({
  view: 'slider',
  label: 'brightness',
  min: 0,
  max: 1,
  value: 0.5,
}) as SliderBladeApi;

// Access slider-specific fields
console.log(b.min, b.max);
.ts

Text

Parameters | API 

const pane = new Pane();
pane.addBlade({
  view: 'text',
  label: 'name',
  parse: (v) => String(v),
  value: 'sketch-01',
});

List

Parameters | API 

const pane = new Pane();
pane.addBlade({
  view: 'list',
  label: 'scene',
  options: [
    {text: 'loading', value: 'LDG'},
    {text: 'menu', value: 'MNU'},
    {text: 'field', value: 'FLD'},
  ],
  value: 'LDG',
});

Button grid

Parameters | API

A grid of buttons, useful for directional pads or quick-pick controls. Built into this fork by default — no registerPlugin() needed.

const pane = new Pane();
pane.addBlade({
  view: 'buttongrid',
  size: [3, 3],
  cells: (x, y) => ({
    title: [
      ['NW', 'N', 'NE'],
      ['W', '*', 'E'],
      ['SW', 'S', 'SE'],
    ][y][x],
  }),
  label: 'nav',
});

Cubic bezier

Parameters | API

An editable cubic-bezier easing curve picker, handy for animation easing values. Built into this fork by default.

const pane = new Pane();
pane.addBlade({
  view: 'cubicbezier',
  value: [0.5, 0, 0.5, 1],
  expanded: true,
  label: 'easing',
  picker: 'inline',
});

FPS graph

Parameters | API

A rolling graph of frames-per-second — wrap your render loop with begin()/end(). Built into this fork by default.

const pane = new Pane();
const fpsGraph = pane.addBlade({
  view: 'fpsgraph',
  label: 'fpsgraph',
  rows: 2,
}) as FpsGraphBladeApi;

function render() {
  fpsGraph.begin();
  // Rendering
  fpsGraph.end();
  requestAnimationFrame(render);
}
render();
